Here is a TikTok video script about the rise of autonomous AI and agent-based workflows:

**HOOK (3 seconds)**
(Upbeat background music starts playing. A futuristic animation of robots and AI systems appears on screen.)

**AI Revolution Alert!**

**BODY (15 seconds)**
(Fast-paced cuts of different AI systems and robots at work, with upbeat background music)

Did you know that AI is no longer just a concept? Autonomous AI is here to transform development! Agent-based workflows are the game-changers. They enable AI systems to learn, adapt, and make decisions without human intervention. Imagine building complex systems, like self-driving cars, without human oversight!

**CTA (5 seconds)**
(Cut to a text overlay with a call to action)

Get ready to revolutionize your workflow! Learn more about agent-based workflows and the future of development! #AIRevolution #AutonomousAI #FutureOfWork

**HASHTAGS**
(Trending hashtags appear on screen)

#TikTokAI #AIinAction #Robotics

This script aims to capture the attention of TikTok users with a hook that grabs their attention, followed by a fast-paced and energetic main content section that highlights the transformative power of autonomous AI and agent-based workflows. The call to action encourages viewers to learn more, and the trending hashtags help increase the video's discoverability.
angle: The Rise of Autonomous AI: How agent-based workflows are transforming development
